clean-control.clock: PX4 HRT microseconds on this boot; host elapsed seconds are separate. No cross-clock upper bound.
clean-control.cpu_limit: Pinned LoadMon.cpp has no Darwin load/RAM calculation branch; zero-initialized fields are published. The recorded zeros cannot bound CPU cost.

native.injection_timing_scope: lower bound only; no calibrated injection latency
native.observation_limit: logging can perturb scheduling; this is a development diagnostic

clean-control.backpressure_limit: ULog dropouts and sampled CPU load do not measure every console/uORB queue wait or blocked callback.

clean-instrumented.clock: PX4 HRT microseconds on this boot; host elapsed seconds are separate. No cross-clock upper bound.
clean-instrumented.cpu_limit: Pinned LoadMon.cpp has no Darwin load/RAM calculation branch; zero-initialized fields are published. The recorded zeros cannot bound CPU cost.

native.injection_timing_scope: lower bound only; no calibrated injection latency
native.observation_limit: logging can perturb scheduling; this is a development diagnostic

native_segments.clock_limit: HRT is quantized by SIH lockstep. Equal entry/exit stamps do not prove zero host execution time. The observed receive is not the host cut instant.
native_segments.commit_marker_limit: UAV_TIME commit follows nav field assignment but precedes nav_state_timestamp assignment; use the ULog nav_state_timestamp for that official stamp.

clean-instrumented.backpressure_limit: ULog dropouts and sampled CPU load do not measure every console/uORB queue wait or blocked callback.

interpretation: A matched fresh-build pair does not identify compiler-cache staleness or a specific scheduling cause. Apply the qualification and protocol gates before any confirmation.
